cases.excerpt: In proxy mode, only external method calls coming in through the proxy are intercepted. This means that self-invocation does not lead to an actual transaction at runtime.
cases.reference: 默认代理模式只拦截经过代理的调用。本对象内部的自调用绕过代理；外层可能已经打开事务。
cases.noRag: 只要标了注解，内部调用一定开启新事务。

cases.excerpt: Actions in a thread prior to the submission of a task happen-before actions taken by that task, which in turn happen-before the result is retrieved via Future.get().
cases.reference: 任务提交方的先前操作对任务可见；通过 Future.get 取回结果时可以看到任务执行的影响。
cases.noRag: 任务提交和 Future.get() 提供了两段内存可见性关系。

cases.excerpt: Include the tool definition in the request. The application sends the tool call result back to the model.
cases.reference: 应用向模型声明工具。应用执行工具后把实际结果返回给模型。
cases.noRag: 模型自行访问应用数据库执行工具。

cases.excerpt: When a user question is sent to the AI model, a QuestionAnswerAdvisor queries the vector database for documents related to the user question.
cases.reference: QuestionAnswerAdvisor 为这个问题查找相关向量库文档，再把检索资料用于回答。
cases.noRag: RAG 会自动给每一个句子生成经过人工核验的引用。
